channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: WATCH: Vasilevskiy And Swayman Drop The Gloves In Stadium Series Goalie Fight
item.description: Tampa Bay Lightning's Andrei Vasilevskiy and Boston Bruins' Jeremy Swayman drop the gloves in a goalie fight during the second period of the Stadium Series matchup at Raymond James Stadium.

item.title: Canada's Olympic Roster May Be Down Another Forward As Lightning's Cirelli Injured In Outdoor Game
item.description: Three weeks after Tampa Bay's Brayden Point suffered a lower-body injury, Lightning teammate Anthony Cirelli left Sunday's outdoor game against the Boston Bruins after taking a hit from Mark Kastelic.

item.title: 2026 Olympic Hockey Hub: Schedules, Rosters, Stories, Lists And More
item.description: The Hockey News has boots on the ground in Milan for the 2026 Olympics. Follow all our coverage throughout the men's and women's hockey tournaments.

item.title: Reports: Predators GM Barry Trotz To Step Down When Successor Is Found
item.description: Barry Trotz made bold moves in parts of three seasons as Nashville Predators GM. Now, he's reportedly stepping down once a successor is found.

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: Updates On Rangers' Artemi Panarin And The Predators
item.description: Several teams are willing to sign New York Rangers left winger Artemi Panarin to a contract extension as part of a trade, while the Predators are considering their trade options.

item.title: Who's Hot And Cold In The NHL: Sabres' Dahlin, Canadiens' Dobes Had A Big Week
item.description: An Edmonton Oilers superstar, Buffalo Sabres D-man and Montreal Canadiens goaltender had hot weeks, while a Winnipeg Jets center and Colorado Avalanche star right winger had the opposite.

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show: Women's Olympic Preview, Plus Trotz, Oilers And More
item.description: Devan Dubnyk joins the show to discuss the Oilers' goaltending, Barry Trotz announcement and more, while Chris Sinclair joins to preview some exciting women's Olympic hockey action.

item.title: Sidney Crosby Can Cement His Status As Canada's Greatest Men's Olympic Hockey Player Ever
item.description: The 2026 Olympics are nearly here, and Team Canada icon Sidney Crosby will try to win a historic third Olympic gold medal. Is Crosby Canada's ultimate Olympic men's hockey player?

item.title: How Barry Trotz And The Predators' Next GM Can Create A Better Path For The Team
item.description: Nashville Predators GM Barry Trotz announced he'll be stepping down, leaving the team's direction wide open. The best direction for the Predators as they pivot from the Trotz Era is to leave the "mushy middle" behind.

item.title: Tragedy Strikes Three Alberta Junior Hockey Players Chasing Their Dreams
item.description: Three teenagers playing for the Southern Alberta Mustangs died Monday in a car accident on their way to practice. Whenever a tragedy of this nature happens, it hits the hockey community very hard.
